items.title: New Platform for CAE Multiphysics Innovation and Talent Development
items.excerpt: Cadence and Jilin University expanded their joint CFD laboratory into a CAE multiphysics laboratory, broadening research and teaching to system simulation, multiphysics analysis and intelligent vehicle development.

items.title: Streamlining SI/PI Analysis with Clarity 3D Solver’s New ACE Technology
items.source: Cadence System, PCB, & Package Design Blog
items.excerpt: Cadence describes Clarity ACE automation for partitioning, channel extraction and parallel electromagnetic simulations, with layout integration through Allegro X and Virtuoso. The post points to a new webinar and technical overview.

items.title: How to Verify and Signoff AI-Generated Design Data
items.excerpt: Cadence outlines verification and signoff controls for agent-generated design changes, tying approved design intent to simulation, formal checks, implementation analysis and reproducible engineering evidence.

items.title: Professionals in CFD with Iva Papeš from Vertiv
items.excerpt: A Vertiv engineering interview explains use of Cadence Reality DC Design for internal and external CFD, cooling-capacity checks, hotspot detection and outdoor heat-recirculation analysis during data-center design.

items.title: Cadence Expands ChipStack AI Super Agent with a New Agent for RTL Generation and Early PPA Optimization
items.excerpt: Cadence introduced an RTL Generation Agent for ChipStack that generates and revises RTL from natural-language specifications with EDA-based verification and PPA optimization. Honda R&D is evaluating the technology.
items.query: direct: previously published-index URL supplied by coordinator

items.title: Autodesk Advances Agentic AI in Its Three Industry Clouds
items.excerpt: Autodesk previewed a next-generation Assistant spanning products, projects and teams, using project context and specialized design, simulation and manufacturing tools. Assistant Builder is intended to connect customers’ agents and tools.

items.title: Autodesk advances AI for design and manufacturing at AU 2026
items.excerpt: Autodesk described AutoTimeline for editable parametric geometry, AutoAssemble, System Modeler manufacturing automation and agentic PLM. It also outlined Assistant workflows in Inventor and Vault and plans for Inventor as a Fusion Connected Client.

items.title: Closing the loop: how operations data improves Design & Make
items.excerpt: Autodesk announced Tandem–FlexSim process-simulation integration and showed connections with Forma and MaintainX, using design, manufacturing and operational data to test facility changes and inform future engineering decisions.

items.title: A More Connected Path from Design to Fabrication in Inventor
items.excerpt: Autodesk completed acquisition of select Klietsch technology and IP associated with SolidSteel parametric and DSTV Assistant for Inventor, adding structural-steel detailing, connection, drawing, BOM and fabrication-data capabilities.

items.title: The next chapter of interoperability starts with connected data
items.excerpt: Autodesk’s September30 update confirms completion of its acquisition of select BIMDeX technology assets and IP, with some staff joining Autodesk. The technology supports CAD/BIM/manufacturing interoperability and preservation of design intent.
items.query: direct: APS September News Recap > linked interoperability article

items.title: The new APS: A developer platform for the AI era
items.excerpt: Autodesk outlined AI-native APS tools including an in-development Workflow MCP for composing API calls, Fusion Compute MCP public beta and new Automation API compute options in private beta.
items.query: direct: APS September News Recap > linked developer-platform article

items.title: What’s New and Next for Fusion Manufacturing: 5 Announcements from IMTS and Autodesk University
items.excerpt: Fusion’s manufacturing roadmap covers full turn-mill machine simulation, local documents, visual System Modeler workflows, automated CAM programming and Fusion Compute MCP. The article distinguishes planned capabilities from the MCP public beta.

items.title: Product Manufacturing Information Comes to Fusion: Keep Manufacturing Intent with the Model
items.excerpt: Fusion added PMI authoring in the Design workspace, including hole/thread and leader notes. Manufacturing and inspection workflows can consume model-linked requirements, and imported PMI can be converted to editable native PMI.

items.title: Changes to Autodesk Assistant in Fusion
items.excerpt: Autodesk detailed Fusion Assistant’s expanded workflows and monthly Flex-token beta allowances for design-working/task-performing AI. The post also recaps three Fusion MCP servers, agentic PLM and Assistant expansion across Inventor, Moldflow and Vault.

items.title: Autodesk Product Design & Manufacturing Collection for Enterprise Manufacturing: Scalability, Multi-Site Operations, and Global Teams
items.excerpt: Autodesk explains enterprise use of PDMC for multi-site design, simulation, factory planning and data management, with Inventor iLogic configuration rules intended to reuse engineering knowledge and support consistent product-development workflows.

items.title: What is iLogic in Autodesk Inventor? A Practical Guide for Design Automation
items.excerpt: An Autodesk guide explains iLogic rules, parameters and forms for configurable mechanical models, automated drawings and assemblies, and reusable engineering standards.

items.title: A Part Is Never Alone: Designing Components That Respect Their Connections
items.excerpt: Autodesk Research describes interface-preserving topology optimization and shape deformation with reduced-order simulation. Both methods preserve joint geometry while allowing component-shape exploration, with links to two Computers and Structures papers.
items.query: direct: https://www.research.autodesk.com/ > Latest Publications and Stories

items.title: Project Quill: Sketch It. Say It. Shape It.
items.excerpt: Autodesk Research demonstrated Project Quill, combining pen sketches, voice input and AI models to create and iteratively revise architectural 3D designs. Integration with Forma and Autodesk Assistant is an area of research.
items.query: direct: https://www.research.autodesk.com/ > Latest Publications and Stories

items.title: [NEW WEBINAR] - AI at work for you: The future of engineering - October 27, 2026
items.excerpt: An Autodesk employee announced an October27 webinar on AI for engineering and manufacturing, including Assistant, design assistance, drawing automation and manufacturing-workflow demonstrations.

items.title: System-Level Modeling and Agentic AI Take the Spotlight in COMSOL Multiphysics® Version 2027
items.excerpt: COMSOL announced a planned release of version 2027 in autumn 2026 with system-level models coupled to multiphysics, an MCP server for AI agents, an Electric Motor Module, and Application Builder support on macOS and Linux.

items.title: COMSOL Named Official Multiphysics Partner of Formula E
items.excerpt: A multiyear Formula E partnership will use COMSOL simulation for interacting vehicle physics and explore simulation apps, digital twins, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.

items.title: Using Agentic Workflows with COMSOL Multiphysics®
items.excerpt: A technical walkthrough connects Codex to a live COMSOL model through the Java API and uses an agent to investigate nonlinear solver settings for a heat-sink CFD model.

items.title: Modeling Acoustic–Structure Interaction in Kaplan Turbine Blades Using COMSOL®
items.excerpt: A guest technical article uses coupled acoustic–structure modeling of a Kaplan turbine blade to capture how surrounding water and blade-to-wall clearance change vibration response.

items.title: Leveraging the mBVD Circuit Model for MEMS Resonator Design
items.excerpt: COMSOL describes reducing finite-element piezoresonator results to a modified Butterworth–Van Dyke equivalent circuit for faster system-level simulation of MEMS/RF designs.

items.title: Optimizing Temperature and Pressure Sensor Placement for In-Package Microwave Heating
items.excerpt: A food-process simulation case study models how wireless sensor orientation affects microwave heating and reflected power, with COMSOL RF results compared against measurements.

items.title: Accessible Color Tables to Aid in Accurate Perception of Results
items.excerpt: COMSOL explains accessible, perceptually uniform color tables for communicating simulation results, including guidance for stress, flow, temperature, and electromagnetic field plots.

items.title: Practical High-Frequency Acoustic Simulation with the Actran Radiosity Solver
items.excerpt: Cadence explains Actran’s energy-based radiosity solver for high-frequency acoustic design, including geometry-based view factors, surface-only discretization, and cabin, factory, and urban-noise examples.

items.title: Why Multibody Dynamics Simulation Belongs in Every Robotics Leader's Toolkit
items.excerpt: Cadence describes Adams modeling of complete industrial robots, including flexible bodies, motors, gears, controls, cable motion and collisions, to support earlier design and validation.

items.title: Cadence VTD 2026.2: Smarter Simulation for ADAS and Automated Driving
items.excerpt: VTD 2026.2 adds early-preview MCP servers for AI-assisted documentation lookup and configuration inspection/editing, alongside simulation robustness, vehicle behavior, and standards improvements.

items.title: Dynamis Power Solutions and Siemens Energy Support Growing U.S. Power Demand with More Than 1.7 GW of Mobile Power Solutions
items.category: ガスタービン・技術サービス
items.excerpt: Dynamis and Siemens Energy announced an agreement for 119 SGT-400 gas-turbine cores for DT18 mobile power packages, with first deliveries in 2027. The cores will be manufactured at Lincoln, UK. More than 1.7 GW is planned; this is a supply commitment, not delivered capacity.

items.title: Hyundai uses Monumo’s Anser AI Platform to transform the way EV motors are designed
items.excerpt: Monumo reports a Hyundai proof of concept using Anser AI for EV motor simulation and optimization, identifying alternative designs and performance/material-cost trade-offs. No quantitative result or independent validation is provided. Discovery: physics-grounded AI and motor-design optimization offer continuing engineering-monitoring value.
